reuse.why: Reuses bank lookup, synchronization and response handling, and shares local unlinking between takeover and ordinary unlink operations.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the account creation or upgrade workflow and authenticated transaction download logic.

placement.why: Link policies, provider downloads, configuration and model types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: Changes stay focused on the requested linking policies and Fintegra integration, with minimal client registry updates.

maintainability.why: Shared policy and unlink helpers simplify future changes, but the copied Fintegra workflows and repeated guard sequencing increase maintenance effort.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared policy helpers, and takeover and ordinary unlink both use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount repeats the existing provider linking workflow with substituted provider fields, while downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated download and response mapping.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared link parameters and holder policy gain replaceExistingLink and its refusal-versus-release branch; every provider routes through that policy.
